target.label: Port completo do engine de regras para TypeScript

rationale: P0 coverage is 100% (6/6 ACs FULL), P1 coverage is 100% (AC-6 FULL), and overall coverage is 100% (7/7 ACs). 55/55 triade tests green (31 unit + 8 parity + 7 matchScore + 2 purity + 4 smoke + 1 suite-parity + 2 benchmark) and the frozen web suite passes 26/26 unchanged. Deterministic RNG everywhere (mulberry32, no Math.random). The differential parity suite proves the TS engine is behaviorally identical to js/game.js, including the exact trace contract. No gaps, no blockers.
